name: lithub-promo
description: 文枢 LitHub 软件宣传动画（Remotion）

scripts.render: node scripts/make-audio.mjs && node scripts/remotion.mjs render src/index.ts LitHubIntro out/lithub-intro.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --crf=17 --concurrency=4
scripts.poster: node scripts/remotion.mjs still src/index.ts LitHubIntro out/lithub-poster.png --frame=600
